The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: needing rest or sleep.

draft.emotion: drained and heavy, like someone who just finished a very long day
notes: Use 'mệt' when you feel physically drained or mentally worn out. It is the most common way to say you are tired.
If you want to say you are exhausted or drained of all energy, you can use the intensifier 'quá' (mệt quá) or 'mệt mỏi'.

senses.definition: Needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental exertion.

examples.text: Tôi cảm thấy mệt sau một ngày làm việc dài.
examples.translation: I feel tired after a long day of work.
examples.emotion: slow and weary, exhaling a deep breath at the end of the day

senses.definition: Feeling bored or annoyed by a situation or a person's behavior.

examples.text: Tôi mệt vì phải đợi anh ấy quá lâu.
examples.translation: I am tired of waiting for him for so long.
examples.emotion: impatient and slightly irritable, rolling one's eyes
